question: A bin has 8 black balls and 7 white balls.  3 of the balls are drawn at random.  What is the probability of drawing 2 of one color and 1 of the other color?
solution:
There are $\binom{15}{3}=15\cdot14\cdot13/6=455$ equally likely unordered draws. Count the two disjoint favorable cases:
- Two black and one white: $\binom{8}{2}\binom{7}{1}=28\cdot7=196$.
- One black and two white: $\binom{8}{1}\binom{7}{2}=8\cdot21=168$.
The probability is $(196+168)/455=364/455=4/5$.
Final answer: \frac{4}{5}
